commonPrompt: Create one standalone transparent editorial illustration for Study Shelf, an adult MCA computing study website. Match sophisticated hand-drawn ink contours and subtle watercolor paper textures. Palette cobalt #2457d6, periwinkle #93b4ff, slate ink, off-white surfaces, warm amber accents, occasional restrained green. Three-quarter elevated perspective, compact cohesive square composition. All objects fully in frame with generous clear margin. Clear readable silhouette at 96px yet detailed enough at 250px. No words, letters, labels, digits, brand marks, people, watermark, photographic backdrop, or background panel. Genuine transparent background. Light highlights and dark outlines suitable on dark navy and pale website backgrounds. Subject-specific symbolic illustration, not an instructional diagram.
